name: BentoShuffleGallery
job: Show photos in an uneven tile layout where tiles trade sizes in turn so each photo gets a moment as the feature
visitor_action: hover or tap a tile to make it the feature; otherwise the gallery rotates the feature by itself; arrow keys choose the feature
motion: feature trade: outgoing tile lifts, winds up and sweeps on a bowed spring arc (tilt, deeper shadow) into the slot of the photo that grows into the 2x2 feature from the opposite bow; neighbours ripple away in its wake (reduced-motion: no auto shuffle, instant swap on tap)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Sorbet bento: matte rounded tiles straight on the host page (no panel), peach and pistachio accents, one big bone caption card on the feature, Bricolage Grotesque ink text
notes: 2026-11-23: composition final round (Sonnet 5.5): resting frame is a trade caught mid-air (flatbread lifted, tilted 5deg, throwing its travel shadow at the empty slot it is landing in; finishes on first touch or after ~8s); tiles are matte prints (paper-stock edge, tooth, contact + travel shadows) on a pistachio plaster table surface; fixed engine bug (plan was indexed by slot, bodies by photo, so promoted tiles never grew) and caption pill now scales with its tile and grows to 4 lines instead of clipping. Checked by eye in the dev server at 1024 / 375 / worst-375 only, shot.sh not run; previous notes: self-hosted Bricolage Grotesque, caption only on feature (others on keyboard focus), hover-promote ignored while a trade settles
